name: Brutal Gauntlets
summary: Ula'elek has finished a pair of Brutal Gauntlets for a seasoned Horde warrior. Rare materials gathered across distant lands have gone into the work, meant to honor both maker and bearer.

sections.title: A Craftsman's Masterpiece
sections.body: Ula'elek brings his lineage and skill to the forging of armor for a seasoned frontline warrior. In Durotar, the Horde craftsman shapes brutal gauntlets from hardened trophies taken from dangerous foes. The finished armor is made to withstand fierce blows and strengthen the wearer's attacks.

sections.title: Ancestral Honor
sections.body: For orcs and trolls, fine arms and armor carry the forge's prestige and the maker's spirit into battle. When Ula'elek presents the finished gauntlets, he entrusts a warrior with his ancestors' legacy. A champion who wears them is expected to meet that craft with courage, martial discipline, and strength.

faq.answer: Ula'elek is a craftsman in Durotar who makes tailored armor for Horde warriors. He asks for exotic materials so his work honors his trade and ancestral traditions.

faq.q: Why were satyr hooves needed for these gauntlets?
faq.answer: Satyr hooves are swollen and uncloven, and hold power leeched from Ashenvale's magic. Ula'elek draws out that power and puts it into the gauntlets, giving them great magic.

faq.q: What does wearing the gauntlets signify to Ula'elek?
faq.answer: To Ula'elek, the gauntlets are the finest work of his craft. Giving them to a worthy warrior honors his trade and ancestors, and ties his labor to the Horde's victories in battle.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
aliases: where is brutal gauntlets turned in
faq.answer: The forging ends in Durotar, the arid homeland of the orcs and Darkspear trolls. There Ula'elek inspects the recovered materials and presents the finished armor.

faq.q: Is this trial intended for all adventurers?
faq.answer: The trial is meant for frontline warriors who have proved their stamina and martial dedication. It marks their rise into more seasoned combat roles within the Horde.

faq.q: What comes after receiving the gauntlets?
faq.answer: Receiving the gauntlets completes this crafting trial. The warrior is equipped to face greater threats across Azeroth's war-torn battlefields.

angles.text: As a warrior, you carry gauntlets made for heavy melee combat. They mark a step toward disciplined martial leadership.
As a member of the Horde, you carry your craftworkers' tradition and martial pride into battle. Their work bears spiritual weight and honor.
